# iLoveIMG

> > iLoveIMG is a comprehensive online image editing platform offering AI-powered tools for background removal, compression, conversion, and photo editing across multiple formats including JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, and RAW.

iLoveIMG provides free and premium web-based image manipulation tools with cloud integration support for Google Drive and Dropbox. The platform is part of the iLovePDF family of online document tools and offers batch processing capabilities for efficient image management workflows.

## Key Topics

- Background removal (AI-powered)
- Image compression and optimization
- Format conversion (JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, RAW, TIFF, PSD)
- Photo editing and filters
- Batch processing
- Cloud integration (Google Drive, Dropbox)
- Premium features and subscriptions
- Meme generator
- Image rotation and resizing
- PNG transparency
- Text overlay and watermarking
- Online image tools
- iLovePDF integration
- Multi-language support
- ISO 27001 compliance

## Core Image Tools

- [Image background remover](https://www.iloveimg.com/remove-background): AI-powered background removal tool for JPG and PNG images
- [이미지 배경 제거 기능](https://www.iloveimg.com/ko/remove-background): AI background remover for JPG/PNG with cloud upload (Korean)
- [Penghapus latar belakang gambar](https://www.iloveimg.com/id/hapus-latar-belakang): AI-powered background removal for JPG/PNG images (Indonesian)
- [Comprimi immagini online con la migliore qualità in pochi secondi.](https://www.iloveimg.com/it/comprimere-immagine): Compress JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF images online (Italian)
- [Безплатен онлайн редактор на снимки. Редактирайте снимката бързо и лесно.](https://www.iloveimg.com/bg/photo-editor): Free online photo editor with text, stickers, filters (Bulgarian)

## Image Conversion Tools

- [Menukar imej dalam pelbagai format kepada JPG dalam sesaat.](https://www.iloveimg.com/ms/convert-to-jpg): Convert PNG, GIF, TIFF, RAW to JPG format (Malay)
- [Convierte imágenes JPG a PNG o a GIF animado](https://www.iloveimg.com/es/jpg-a-imagen): Convert JPG to PNG or animated GIF online (Spanish)
- [Putar imej dalam sesaat secara percuma!](https://www.iloveimg.com/ms/rotate-image): Rotate JPG, PNG, GIF images online (Malay)
- [Meme generator. Maak de grappigste memes online.](https://www.iloveimg.com/nl/meme-generator): Online meme maker with text overlay and custom fonts (Dutch)
